title: Excellent day tour to 3 amazing towns of Seville
text:
A very nice and fruitful day trip, it is so worthy to go with, it is so amazing to go through 3 little wonderful towns of Seville. Your guide show his professional with detailed explanations of every famous spot, he is so considerate and tried his best to arrange everytime all rounded. Appreciated his professionalism. 
It would be great if we can stay longer in Setenil.
author: L7809ZPcherylt

title: Seville
text: Elena was an amazing guide very knowledgeable about her beautiful city, she took us through streets that we would never have experienced on our own, the flamenco museum is well worth a visit and if you can try & book a show show, although the boat cruise was lovely to see a different side of the city, we found it difficult to follow the commentary, but still a very relaxing way to end the day
author: lesleymU5880BC

title: Seville rio
text: Elena was an amazing guide, extremely knowledgeable of her beautiful city, very friendly, she took us to places that we would never have found wandering around on our own, the flamenco museum is well worth a visit, and if you can fit in a flamenco show I would highly recommend it, although the boat cruise was lovely to see a different side of the city we found it hard to follow  the commentary, but relaxing all the same after the walking tour
author: Lesley_M
